# Copilot instructions for Kanban Android

Read `AGENTS.md` before editing. Use the original engineering skills in `.agents/skills/` according to the task. For UI, apply `frontend-ui-engineering`; for Kotlin/Gradle failures, `debugging-and-error-recovery`; for CI, `ci-cd-and-automation`; for user data and Android bridges, `security-and-hardening`. Before claiming completion, use `code-review-and-quality` and verify the relevant checks. Do not claim a successful APK build unless it actually passed.
